method: This audit was performed by the same session that built the architecture (not a fresh independent agent), but every finding below is grounded in a specific, checkable artifact - a test, a real preserved run, or a direct code read - rather than asserted from memory. Flagged explicitly where independence is weaker than a fresh-agent audit would provide.

findings.check: Pass A never imports semantic/compile|normalize|caller, semantic-verification, semantic-precedent, /ir/, discovery, context-retrieval.
semantic-verification/* never imports semantic-accountability/*; the real validation harness strips sourceContext/frozenInventory before calling the verifier.
findings.evidence: Same independence test + docs/semantic-accountability/20-verifier-independence.json (verifierOperativeSource field on every real region).

findings.check: No accountability logic keyed to a real benchmark identifier (metric name, section number, defined term, GT amount, basket name).
findings.evidence: Independence test's benchmark-identifier scan of non-comment code passes. CAVEAT: prose comments in tools.ts/prompt.ts (pre-existing, not written by this mission) illustrate with generic example names like 'Consolidated EBITDA' - never in executable logic. Not a violation but noted for a future scan.

findings.check: Did real validation surface a genuine architecture defect the synthetic corpus missed?
findings.evidence: docs/semantic-accountability/06-shared-cap-root-cause.json realValidationDefectsFound; 0 dangling-lineage regressions after the fix in both post-fix holdout runs.

findings.check: Does the digest-based id canonicalization silently accept a genuinely wrong id, widening false credit?
findings.evidence: Regression test proves a same-shape-but-wrong id (24 hex chars, no real item) stays dangling; canonicalization only fires on an exact 24-hex-char digest match against a REAL frozen item.

findings.check: Is the 90.1% holdout disposition-stability result explained away or reported honestly?
findings.evidence: docs/semantic-accountability/14-holdout-stability.json gate 'dispositionStability' explicitly marked pass:false; inventoryVariance (372) vastly exceeds compositionVariance (0) - the instability is almost entirely in WHAT Pass A inventories on a second real-model pass, not in how a shared item is dispositioned.

findings.check: Is the 3/12-region whole-agreement result presented as if it were the full validation?
findings.evidence: 15-whole-agreement-run-1.json explicitly reports regionsCompleted=3, regionsEnvironmentBlocked=9; 16/17 explicitly NOT_MEASURED; 18-shared-cap-validation.json explicitly NOT_MEASURED_ON_REAL_CONTENT.

findings.check: Does accountability.semanticallyComplete=true on individual units get overstated as agreement-level completeness?
findings.evidence: 19-agreement-level-coverage.json: all 3 real runs classified SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE at the rollup level because the INDEPENDENT verifier found MATERIAL_DISCREPANCY findings in nearly every region, even where accountability's own signal said complete - the two layers are not conflated.

findings.check: Was the discarded Haiku 4.5 run and the model-substitution decision fully disclosed rather than quietly dropped from the record?
findings.evidence: tests/fixtures/semantic-accountability-validation/holdout/run-1-haiku-discarded/DISCARDED.md preserved, never deleted; 07-implementation-results.json / commit history record the decision.

findings.check: Was the pre-canonicalization-fix Sonnet-5 run (which looked like a total architecture failure) hidden once the real cause was found?
findings.evidence: tests/fixtures/semantic-accountability-validation/holdout/run-1-pre-canonicalization-fix/DISCARDED.md preserved with full root-cause explanation, never deleted.

findings.check: Did every real paid call execute against a hash-verified frozen tree?
findings.evidence: scripts/semantic-accountability-validation.ts calls assertProductionFrozen() first and refuses to run on drift; every preserved run-summary.json records productionSha+productionTreeHash (78c9fb1 for the discarded pre-fix run, 976a565 for all fixed-code runs).

findings.check: Is real spend fully accounted for and disclosed, including the wasted/diagnostic portion?
findings.evidence: Every run-summary.json carries totalCostUsd; this session's chat record discloses the $11.22 spent on discarded runs separately from the ~$20 spent on evidence used in the final verdict.

findings.check: Can a lineage claim earn REPRESENTED for a valued item without the value itself appearing in the IR?
Do real cross-references that could not be resolved get silently dropped?
findings.evidence: Real holdout regions (interest-expense, applicable-liquidity-rate) show unresolvedReferences counts (5-7) disclosed on every run, both pre- and post-fix - never zero when references genuinely could not resolve.

findings.check: Is the mission's own required shared-cap real-content validation actually complete?
findings.evidence: 18-shared-cap-validation.json: NOT_MEASURED_ON_REAL_CONTENT - the pre-registered cross-reference-dsgr region never executed (ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED). This is the single most significant open item blocking full Phase 3 closure.

findings.check: Is this audit performed by an agent independent of the one that built the fix?
findings.evidence: This audit was NOT performed by a separate/fresh agent (unlike several prior missions in this codebase's history, e.g. 3F.1.3/3F.1.4's dispatched auditor agents). Every finding is evidence-grounded (cites a specific file/test/run), which partially mitigates this, but a genuinely independent re-audit is recommended before Phase 4.

findings.check: Are the 9 ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED whole-agreement regions ever miscounted as compile failures, verification failures, or 'nothing material found'?
findings.evidence: 19-agreement-level-coverage.json's rollup script explicitly filters out PROVIDER_FAILURE units before computing the rollup, rather than counting them as SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE units on the architecture's own merits; 15-whole-agreement-run-1.json labels each with environmentBlocked:true and the verbatim 402 message.
